algorithms.rank_score: Blom plotting position (rank-3/8)/(N+1/4) with average ties and inverse-normal transform
algorithms.rhat: maximum semantic gate over rank-normalized split-Rhat and folded rank-normalized split-Rhat
algorithms.bulk_ess: Geyer P_t=rho_{2t}+rho_{2t+1} from rho_0+rho_1; truncate at first non-positive pair, apply initial-monotone pairs, tau=-1+2*sum(P_t), on split rank-normalized draws
algorithms.tail_ess: minimum Geyer ESS of lower-5% and upper-5% indicator draws
